# Configurable rule criteria screenshots

These screenshots show the shared rule-criteria builder used by resource rule forms:

- `status-page-monitor-rule-match-all.png` — a status page monitor rule that requires every condition.
- `status-page-monitor-rule-match-any.png` — the same criteria configured to match any condition.
- `status-page-owner-rule-match-any.png` — the shared builder in an owner-rule form.
